page.overview:
What is Sideshow?

Sideshow is a plain brown bear. The animatronic Mandy Mason finds has flat brown fur that sags on the frame of the body. Its ears droop, one eye is closed while the other is open, and its mouth is sewn shut.

Little can be gathered about Sideshow's functionality from his appearance in his story, as he appears deactivated when he's found by Mandy.

Sideshow appears as the mascot of Sideshow's Snack Shack for three years before being shut down after a boy named Stevie Robins goes missing. 17 years later, a girl named Mandy is guided to the old building and finds Sideshow in a deactivated state. After removing the animatronic's head, she finds Stevie's decayed corpse inside, presumably having hid there without being able to get out.
